lines.zh: 我一步一步走过整片热带草原。
lines.en: I cross the whole savanna one step at a time.

lines.zh: 象群在前面，我跟着走。
lines.en: The herd is ahead; I walk with them.

lines.zh: 长牙碰到矮树，我把枝拨开。
lines.en: My tusk meets a sapling; I push the branch aside.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下去，草都伏了。
lines.en: My foot comes down and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 小象走慢了，我停下来等。
lines.en: The calf lags; I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 我挑硬一点的路走，省得陷进土里。
lines.en: I pick the firmer ground so I don't sink.

lines.zh: 无牙的那几只走在外圈。
lines.en: The tuskless ones walk on the outside.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩起来，赶开背上的虫。
lines.en: I swing my tail to brush off the flies.

lines.zh: 我们排成一列，往水边去。
lines.en: We form a line and head for the water.

lines.zh: 我抬脚很高，落下去很轻。
lines.en: I lift my feet high and set them down gently.

lines.zh: 金合欢的枝条擦过我的背。
lines.en: Acacia branches brush along my back.

lines.zh: 长牙象走在最前面，谁也不敢挡。
lines.en: The tusked one leads; nobody dares block the way.

lines.zh: 地面在震，那是我走过来了。
lines.en: The ground shakes — that's me walking.

lines.zh: 我踩过的坑，够小动物躲雨。
lines.en: The prints I leave could shelter small creatures from rain.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起一把草，边走边吃
lines.en: I curl up grass with my trunk and eat as I walk.

lines.zh: 小象跟在我的影子下面
lines.en: The calf walks inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 我立起身子，够那根金合欢枝
lines.en: I rear up to reach that acacia branch.

lines.zh: 过河时我先试了试水底的泥
lines.en: At the river I test the mud with one foot.

lines.zh: 一头接一头，队伍不会散。
lines.en: Head to tail, the herd stays whole.

lines.zh: 象群走过草原，脚印很深。
lines.en: The herd crosses the savanna, leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 体重大，走一步歇半步。
lines.en: This much weight means a pause every step.

lines.zh: 我这身板，得侧着过。
lines.en: A body this size has to squeeze through sideways.

lines.zh: 象道是我踩出来的，跟着走。
lines.en: I wore this trail into the grass. Follow it.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被踩得一陷一陷。
lines.en: The dirt sinks with every step we take.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子先碰到前面的树。
lines.en: My trunk reaches the tree before I do.

lines.zh: 象群走在后面，我带头。
lines.en: The herd follows; I lead.

lines.zh: 是我走过来了，地面才响。
lines.en: The ground rings because I'm walking.

lines.zh: 象群走过，草都伏下去。
lines.en: Where my herd walks, the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 影子被踩乱了，我不高兴。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 象群走得慢，我殿后。
lines.en: The herd moves slow; I bring up the rear.

lines.zh: 象群走过的草，全倒了。
lines.en: The grass the herd walks on is all flattened.

lines.zh: 象群在前面，我跟在最后。
lines.en: The herd's ahead; I walk at the back.

lines.zh: 前腿有点酸，走慢些。
lines.en: My front legs ache. Slow down.

lines.zh: 抬头走，象群里没人回头。
lines.en: Heads up — no one in the herd looks back.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得这条路发白。
lines.en: The sun has bleached this path white.

lines.zh: 一地落叶，踩上去沙沙响。
lines.en: Leaves everywhere — they crunch underfoot.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，耳朵慢慢扇。
lines.en: I stand still, ears fanning slowly.

lines.zh: 风从草原那头吹过来，带着草味。
lines.en: Wind comes off the savanna, smelling of grass.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子卷起来，闻了闻天。
lines.en: I curl my trunk up and sniff the sky.

lines.zh: 象群都在歇，小象挤在我腿边。
lines.en: The herd rests; the calf presses against my leg.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子给自己洒了点土。
lines.en: I spray a little dust over my back with my trunk.

lines.zh: 远处的树上有鸟在叫。
lines.en: Birds are calling in the trees far off.

lines.zh: 我靠在一棵金合欢旁打盹。
lines.en: I doze beside an acacia tree.

lines.zh: 耳朵扇一扇，热气就散了些。
lines.en: A flap of the ears and some heat leaves.

lines.zh: 长牙搁在地上，沉得很。
lines.en: My tusks rest on the ground, heavy.

lines.zh: 我记得这里以前有片水洼。
lines.en: I remember there used to be a pool here.

lines.zh: 无牙的同伴在给我理背上的毛。
lines.en: A tuskless companion grooms the hair on my back.

lines.zh: 我低低地叫一声，象群就安静了。
lines.en: I rumble once and the herd falls quiet.

lines.zh: 象群都站着，我也只能站。
lines.en: The herd stands, so I stand too.

lines.zh: 鼻子刚卷起一根草，又放下了。
lines.en: My trunk lifted a tuft of grass and put it down.

lines.zh: 站着，把鼻子搭在背上。
lines.en: Standing, my trunk laid over my back.

lines.zh: 风停时，我用耳朵扇一扇。
lines.en: When the wind dies, my ears do the work.

lines.zh: 树荫挪过去，太阳晒到背。
lines.en: The shade shifts and the sun finds my back.

lines.zh: 安静下来，只听见肚子响。
lines.en: In the quiet, only my stomach speaks.

lines.zh: 树冠底下凉快，就待这。
lines.en: It's cool under the canopy. I'll stay.

lines.zh: 鼻子卷起一撮草，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: My trunk rolls up a tuft and I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 草原这么大，象群也很小。
lines.en: The savanna is vast, and even the herd is small.

lines.zh: 这片沙，我数到一百粒。
lines.en: I counted a hundred grains of this sand.

lines.zh: 鼻子卷起一把土，撒在背上。
lines.en: My trunk scoops up dust and flings it on my back.

lines.zh: 象群走路，地面都在响。
lines.en: When the herd walks, the ground answers.

lines.zh: 你站得离象群太近了。
lines.en: You're standing too close to the herd.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，闻清你的味道。
lines.en: I lift my trunk and take your scent.

lines.zh: 你不是草原上的动物。
lines.en: You're not a creature of this savanna.

lines.zh: 你手里那根长东西，是做什么的？
lines.en: What is that long thing in your hands?

lines.zh: 小象在我身后，你看见了吗？
lines.en: The calf is behind me — do you see it?

lines.zh: 我们走我们的，你别跟太紧。
lines.en: We go our way; don't follow too closely.

lines.zh: 你的个头，还不到我的腿高。
lines.en: You barely reach the height of my leg.

lines.zh: 我盯了你很久，你才动。
lines.en: I watched you a long time before you moved.

lines.zh: 长牙象在前面，你绕开走。
lines.en: The tusked one is ahead; go around.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有火把的影子。
lines.en: There's torchlight reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像火和铁。
lines.en: You smell of fire and iron.

lines.zh: 你手里那根，是草还是棍子？
lines.en: That thing in your hand — grass or a stick?

lines.zh: 象群里，我站在最外面。
lines.en: Of the herd, I stand on the outer edge.

lines.zh: 你的手心里有草的味道。
lines.en: Your palm smells of grass.

lines.zh: 象群里，我一眼看见你。
lines.en: Across the herd, I spot you at once.

lines.zh: 我的象群在树后，别乱动。
lines.en: My herd is behind the trees — do not move.

lines.zh: 你还没草高，倒是敢靠近。
lines.en: You're shorter than the grass, and still you come close.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵扇一下，你就退。
lines.en: One flap of my ear and you step back.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，是象群的道。
lines.en: You're standing on the herd's trail.

lines.zh: 别在我鼻子底下弯腰捡东西。
lines.en: Don't stoop to pick things up under my trunk.

lines.zh: 谁的长矛刺进了我的肩。
lines.en: Someone's spear went into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，整片草原都听见。
lines.en: I bellow, and the whole savanna hears it.

lines.zh: 这张厚皮挡了大部分，剩下的还是疼。
lines.en: This thick hide stops most of it; the rest still stings.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把象群挡在身后。
lines.en: I step back, shielding the herd behind me.

lines.zh: 血顺着腿流到脚背上。
lines.en: Blood runs down my leg onto my foot.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把那东西甩开。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw it off.

lines.zh: 小象在叫，我得站住。
lines.en: The calf is calling; I must stay standing.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记得是谁给的。
lines.en: I'll remember who dealt that blow.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，鼻子还在卷。
lines.en: I'm panting, but my trunk still curls.

lines.zh: 受伤的象，比平时更难劝走。
lines.en: A wounded elephant is harder to turn aside.

lines.zh: 这么重的腿还在动。
lines.en: Legs this heavy, still moving.

lines.zh: 这一下，我厚皮也挡不住。
lines.en: Even my thick hide couldn't stop that one.

lines.zh: 我退两步，象群会跟上来。
lines.en: Two steps back, and the herd will close in.

lines.zh: 耳朵根都被你打疼了。
lines.en: You got me right behind the ear.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子一甩，树都断。
lines.en: One swing of my trunk breaks trees.

lines.zh: 我的牙根被震得发麻。
lines.en: The blow left my tusk roots numb.

lines.zh: 这一下，整群象都惊了。
lines.en: That one startled the whole herd.

lines.zh: 我这四条腿撑得住一整个象群。
lines.en: These four legs carry a whole herd.

lines.zh: 谁在我的肋上戳了一下？
lines.en: Who poked me in the ribs?

lines.zh: 腿沉得抬不起来，等一下。
lines.en: My legs are too heavy to lift. Wait.

lines.zh: 你手里有金合欢花？给我闻闻。
lines.en: Acacia flowers in your hand? Let me smell them.

lines.zh: 那束叶子看着很嫩。
lines.en: That bundle of leaves looks tender.

lines.zh: 花在哪儿摘的，带我去。
lines.en: Where did you pick those flowers? Take me there.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸过来，就闻一下。
lines.en: I reach my trunk over — just to smell.

lines.zh: 金合欢花甜，我很久没吃到了。
lines.en: Acacia flowers are sweet; I haven't had them in ages.

lines.zh: 再举高些，我的鼻子差一截。
lines.en: A bit higher — my trunk falls just short.

lines.zh: 为了那朵花，我肯站起来。
lines.en: For that flower, I'm willing to rear up.

lines.zh: 叶子留一半，别全给了。
lines.en: Keep half the leaves; don't give them all.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起旱季前的草原。
lines.en: This smell takes me back to the savanna before the dry season.

lines.zh: 你退后，我自己卷过来拿。
lines.en: Step back; I'll curl my trunk over and take it.

lines.zh: 就舔一下，你手里的树皮。
lines.en: Just one lick of the bark in your hand.

lines.zh: 亮亮的东西，也能吃吗？
lines.en: Something shiny — can it be eaten?

lines.zh: 熟透的果子味，我鼻子发痒。
lines.en: Ripe fruit — my trunk itches for it.

lines.zh: 我只要一口，连皮一起吃。
lines.en: Just one bite, peel and all.

lines.zh: 那棵树上的嫩叶，归我这一群。
lines.en: The young leaves on that tree belong to my herd.

lines.zh: 草举那么高，我鼻子够不到。
lines.en: Held that high, the grass is past my trunk.

lines.zh: 象群里，我走在最小的后面。
lines.en: In the herd, I walk behind the youngest.

lines.zh: 我的腿自己动了。
lines.en: My legs moved on their own.

lines.zh: 金合欢的叶子，我站起来够。
lines.en: I rear up for the acacia leaves.

lines.zh: 把草放下，别举那么高。
lines.en: Set the grass down. Don't hold it so high.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞一棵树。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a tree.

lines.zh: 我这身重量，碰一下你就退三步。
lines.en: This much weight sends you back three steps.

lines.zh: 别站到象群中间来。
lines.en: Don't stand in the middle of the herd.

lines.zh: 我的长牙擦过你的肩。
lines.en: My tusk grazed your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的脚，我抬起来了。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; I lifted it.

lines.zh: 小象被你挤开了，我把它护回来。
lines.en: You crowded the calf; I'll shepherd it back.

lines.zh: 这一碰不算攻击，是提醒。
lines.en: That nudge wasn't an attack — it was a warning.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了挪，给你让路。
lines.en: I shuffled aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 你被我的尾巴扫了一下。
lines.en: My tail swept you once.

lines.zh: 象群挤在一起，本来就难免碰撞。
lines.en: In a tight herd, collisions are unavoidable.

lines.zh: 我把你挡在长牙象外面。
lines.en: I'm keeping you outside the tusked one's reach.

lines.zh: 你退开，我不会再让第二次。
lines.en: Back off; I won't yield twice.

lines.zh: 让让，我这身板收不住。
lines.en: Move — this body of mine can't stop.

lines.zh: 象群走在草原上，地都在抖。
lines.en: The herd walks, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我的触角歪了。
lines.en: My antennae are bent.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞一下够你记。
lines.en: One bump from my bulk will be remembered.

lines.zh: 象道窄，你先退到草里。
lines.en: The trail is narrow. Step into the grass.

lines.zh: 我站在原处，是你冲锋的。
lines.en: I stood still, you were the one charging.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚趾了，很重。
lines.en: You stepped on my toe. It's heavy.

lines.zh: 我这身量，撞一下地都晃。
lines.en: At my size, one bump shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞一下你就飞了。
lines.en: At my size, one nudge sends you flying.

lines.zh: 我这鼻子比你胳膊还粗。
lines.en: My trunk is thicker than your arm.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰你，算认识了。
lines.en: I touched you with my trunk — now we know each other.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是鼻子，不是墙。
lines.en: You hit my trunk, not a wall.

lines.zh: 我与你并肩走，象群会认我们。
lines.en: Walk beside me and the herd will accept us.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像雨后的草原。
lines.en: You smell like the savanna after rain.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰你的额头。
lines.en: I touch my trunk to your brow.

lines.zh: 长牙会留给我们的孩子。
lines.en: The tusks will pass to our young.

lines.zh: 我们一起把树皮剥开。
lines.en: Let's peel the bark back together.

lines.zh: 你走外圈，我走内侧。
lines.en: You take the outside; I'll walk the inside.

lines.zh: 两头象站在一起，影子连成一片。
lines.en: Two elephants side by side, our shadows joined.

lines.zh: 我低吼，你也回我一声。
lines.en: I rumble; answer me with your own.

lines.zh: 等旱季过去，我们再选地方。
lines.en: When the dry season passes, we'll choose a place.

lines.zh: 你慢一点，我的腿比你长。
lines.en: Slow down; my legs are longer than yours.

lines.zh: 先绕着我走一圈，慢慢来。
lines.en: Circle me once. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我们的巢会很暖。
lines.en: Our nest will be warm.

lines.zh: 别绕圈，跟着我的鼻子走。
lines.en: Don't circle — follow my trunk.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰你，是打招呼。
lines.en: My trunk touching you is a greeting.

lines.zh: 象群里少见你这样的小家伙。
lines.en: The herd rarely sees a little one like you.

lines.zh: 跟我回象群，路我熟。
lines.en: Come back to the herd with me. I know the way.

lines.zh: 象群走成一条线，都跟着我。
lines.en: The herd walks single file behind me.

lines.zh: 别怕，我很温柔。
lines.en: Don't fear. I'm gentle.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，你得靠过来点。
lines.en: I'm big; you'll have to come closer.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子，会跟着队伍。
lines.en: Our calves will follow the herd.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起那根树枝。
lines.en: I curl my trunk around that branch.

lines.zh: 花朵得轻拿，别捏碎了。
lines.en: Flowers need a light grip; don't crush them.

lines.zh: 这东西比看起来重。
lines.en: This is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我把木头卷起来，甩到一边。
lines.en: I coil the log up and toss it aside.

lines.zh: 鼻子一勾，整串果子都下来了。
lines.en: One hook of the trunk brings the whole bunch down.

lines.zh: 小件的东西我可夹不住。
lines.en: I can't pinch anything small.

lines.zh: 我把它举高，够到那个树杈。
lines.en: I lift it high to reach that fork.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我用脚背推走。
lines.en: I shove the fallen thing along with my foot.

lines.zh: 卷起来的力气，比咬更管用。
lines.en: A trunk's grip works better than teeth.

lines.zh: 我把它放进小象够得到的地方。
lines.en: I set it where the calf can reach.

lines.zh: 象群都围过来了，分着吃。
lines.en: The herd has gathered round to share it.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起来，扛在背上。
lines.en: I curl it with my trunk and carry it on my back.

lines.zh: 这根树干太粗，卷不动。
lines.en: This trunk is too thick to curl.

lines.zh: 带回去给小象，它正长牙。
lines.en: Back to the calf; it's growing its tusks.

lines.zh: 长鼻子一卷，就到你手上。
lines.en: One curl of my trunk reaches your hand.

lines.zh: 一捆嫩枝，够嚼一阵子。
lines.en: A bundle of young twigs — that's a good chew.

lines.zh: 鼻子卷着，往肩上一甩。
lines.en: My trunk curls it up and flips it onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 用鼻子卷起来，挺称手。
lines.en: Curled up in my trunk, it sits nicely.

lines.zh: 这块归我，象群要先吃。
lines.en: This one's mine — the herd eats first.

lines.zh: 存起来，旱季还长。
lines.en: Store it; the dry season is long.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里动，我先看见了。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass — I saw it first.

lines.zh: 那棵金合欢的花开得正好。
lines.en: That acacia's flowers are just right.

lines.zh: 有人靠小象太近了。
lines.en: Someone is too close to the calf.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥味，从那边来。
lines.en: I smell blood, coming from over there.

lines.zh: 那群鬣狗在我侧后方转。
lines.en: Those hyenas are circling my flank.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那丛没被啃过的叶。
lines.en: I've picked out that untouched stand of leaves.

lines.zh: 前面有个身影挡住了象群的路。
lines.en: A figure ahead blocks the herd's path.

lines.zh: 那根长矛对准的是小象。
lines.en: That spear is aimed at the calf.

lines.zh: 有东西在偷我的草料。
lines.en: Something is stealing my forage.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那棵最高的金合欢。
lines.en: I've fixed on the tallest acacia.

lines.zh: 它在我背后，我不转身也能感到。
lines.en: It's behind me; I feel it without turning.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但离幼崽太近。
lines.en: A small target, but far too near the young.

lines.zh: 别动，让我先看看你是谁。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me see what you are.

lines.zh: 跑不过四条腿，省点力气。
lines.en: You can't outrun four legs. Save your breath.

lines.zh: 这一声，整片草原都听见。
lines.en: The whole savanna hears this one.

lines.zh: 象群里最老的，是我。
lines.en: The oldest of the herd is me.

lines.zh: 象群在我身后，你确定？
lines.en: The herd is behind me, are you sure?

lines.zh: 长鼻子一指，就是你。
lines.en: One point of my trunk — you.

lines.zh: 象群就位，我冲过去了。
lines.en: The herd is set. Here I charge.

lines.zh: 象群在后头，我先来。
lines.en: The herd is behind me. I go first.

lines.zh: 你站在象群中间，出不去了。
lines.en: You're in the middle of the herd now.

lines.zh: 四条柱腿已经刨过土了。
lines.en: All four pillars of my legs have pawed the dirt.

lines.zh: 我不急，我先摆好脚步。
lines.en: No hurry. First I set my feet.

lines.zh: 象群停下，我转过身来。
lines.en: The herd halts; I turn around.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把长牙对准它。
lines.en: I turn slowly and level my tusks at it.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我踩松了。
lines.en: The soil loosens under my feet.

lines.zh: 我先低吼，让它知道我要来。
lines.en: I rumble first so it knows I'm coming.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我准备冲。
lines.en: Enough distance; I'm ready to charge.

lines.zh: 我把小象推到象群中间。
lines.en: I push the calf into the middle of the herd.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我进一步。
lines.en: It backs half a step; I take one forward.

lines.zh: 我绕到它的侧面，堵住退路。
lines.en: I circle to its flank and cut off retreat.

lines.zh: 象群散开，给我让出一条路。
lines.en: The herd parts and clears a path for me.

lines.zh: 耳朵张开，这是冲锋前的样子。
lines.en: Ears spread wide — that's how a charge begins.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，那儿最容易倒下。
lines.en: I watch its legs; that's where it falls easiest.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，给它离开的机会。
lines.en: I pause and give it a chance to leave.

lines.zh: 它没走，那就别怪我了。
lines.en: It didn't leave — don't blame me now.

lines.zh: 别让我跑起来，地会震。
lines.en: Don't make me run. The ground will shake.

lines.zh: 前面是岩壁，你撞不过去。
lines.en: That's a rock wall ahead. You won't break through.

lines.zh: 象群已经把路堵住了。
lines.en: The herd has already blocked the road.

lines.zh: 这里我熟。
lines.en: I know this place.

lines.zh: 我的长鼻能卷起树枝。
lines.en: My trunk can curl up a whole branch.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，别急。
lines.en: One of my steps is three of yours.

lines.zh: 你脚步越来越乱，跑不远了。
lines.en: Your steps are getting ragged. You won't get far.

lines.zh: 我这长鼻子，能把你甩出去。
lines.en: This trunk can throw you clear.

lines.zh: 草丛那阵窸窣，就在我背后。
lines.en: That rustle in the grass is right behind me.

lines.zh: 我拐得慢，可我腿长。
lines.en: I turn slowly, but my legs are long.

lines.zh: 尘土里全是你的味道。
lines.en: The dust is full of your scent.

lines.zh: 象群走起来地面会响。
lines.en: The herd makes the ground rumble.

lines.zh: 我低头冲过去，长牙先到。
lines.en: I lower my head and charge; tusks arrive first.

lines.zh: 鼻子卷住它，甩向旁边的树。
lines.en: My trunk seizes it and flings it at a tree.

lines.zh: 我立起来，前脚落在它身上。
lines.en: I rear up and bring my forefeet down on it.

lines.zh: 这一踏，地都陷下去。
lines.en: After that stomp, the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我把它推得连滚几圈。
lines.en: I shove it rolling across the grass.

lines.zh: 长牙挑起，再甩出去。
lines.en: The tusk hooks under and flings it away.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶，骨头会响。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder in; bones will creak.

lines.zh: 它躲开了第一下，躲不开第二下。
lines.en: It dodged the first, not the second.

lines.zh: 我踩下去之前，先看了小象一眼。
lines.en: Before I stomp, I glance at the calf.

lines.zh: 冲锋的尽头，它已经站不起来。
lines.en: At the charge's end, it can't stand.

lines.zh: 退后，还想要？
lines.en: Back off. Want more?

lines.zh: 一鼻子下去，铁甲也扁。
lines.en: One swing of my trunk flattens iron.

lines.zh: 象牙擦过，算你走运。
lines.en: My tusk grazed you — lucky.

lines.zh: 我这吨位，一踩一个坑。
lines.en: At my weight, every step leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 象鼻甩起来，趁现在。
lines.en: Trunk swinging — now.

lines.zh: 象鼻抽中，你听着这声。
lines.en: Trunk connects — hear that?

lines.zh: 你比想的慢。
lines.en: You're slower than I thought.

lines.zh: 象鼻甩过去，一下。
lines.en: Trunk swings out — once.

lines.zh: 象牙一挑，你就离地了。
lines.en: My tusk flicks, and your feet leave the ground.

lines.zh: 象牙一挑，你就飞了。
lines.en: One flick of my tusks and you fly.

lines.zh: 我从草原的草丛里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the savanna grass.

lines.zh: 象群就在不远处，我认得它们。
lines.en: The herd is nearby; I know them.

lines.zh: 第一次抬脚，地面就凹了下去。
lines.en: My first step dents the ground.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着胎毛的味道。
lines.en: I still carry the smell of birth fur.

lines.zh: 阳光很烈，我找了个树荫。
lines.en: The sun is fierce; I find shade under a tree.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷了第一把草。
lines.en: I curl my trunk around my first mouthful of grass.

lines.zh: 远处有长牙在反光。
lines.en: Tusks glint in the distance.

lines.zh: 小象们都围过来看我。
lines.en: The calves gather round to look at me.

lines.zh: 我得先学会怎么用这鼻子。
lines.en: First I must learn how to use this trunk.

lines.zh: 这片草原，够我们走很久。
lines.en: This savanna is wide enough to walk a long time.

lines.zh: 这里是草原吗？
lines.en: Is this undergrowth?

lines.zh: 草原上，我的鼻子先碰到草。
lines.en: On the savanna, my trunk finds the grass first.

lines.zh: 我在草原上跟着母亲走。
lines.en: I follow my mother across the savanna.

lines.zh: 小象摔了，整群都围回来。
lines.en: A calf stumbles and the whole herd turns back.

lines.zh: 耳朵一扇，我醒过来了。
lines.en: One flap of my ears, and I'm awake.

lines.zh: 小象落地，第一口就是奶。
lines.en: A calf drops, and my first mouthful is milk.

lines.zh: 我从草原的尘土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the savanna dust.

lines.zh: 跟着队伍走，就不会迷路。
lines.en: Stay with the herd and you won't get lost.

lines.zh: 太阳太大，我得找片树荫。
lines.en: The sun is fierce — I need some shade.

lines.zh: 热带草原的风，先吹到我鼻子。
lines.en: The savanna wind reaches my trunk first.

lines.zh: 火燎到象皮，我踏灭了那片草。
lines.en: Fire sears my hide; I stamp the grass out.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤太厚，还是烫。
lines.en: My hide is thick, and still it burns.

lines.zh: 我从高坡滑下，压塌了一片灌木。
lines.en: I slid down the slope and flattened the brush.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，四腿都软。
lines.en: Falling from that height left all four legs weak.

lines.zh: 水漫到我的背，我抬着鼻子走。
lines.en: Water reaches my back; I walk with my trunk raised.

lines.zh: 水进鼻子了，快拉我上去！
lines.en: Water's in my trunk — pull me up!

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪推得我偏了半步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me half a step sideways.

lines.zh: 轰一声，我被掀得翻过去。
lines.en: A blast rolled me right over.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在耳朵上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ear like a thorn.

lines.zh: 扎在皮上的刺，拔不掉。
lines.en: The barb in my hide won't come out.

lines.zh: 药水泼在背上，皮肤一阵凉。
lines.en: Potion splashed my back; my skin goes cold.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进我的厚皮。
lines.en: Something cold crawled under my thick hide.

lines.zh: 旱季太长，草根都干了。
lines.en: The dry season drags on; even roots are dry.

lines.zh: 草根都啃完了，饿得慌。
lines.en: The grass roots are gone. I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷落在金合欢上，我护住小象。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the acacia; I shield the calf.

lines.zh: 雷劈在背上，牙都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back; my tusks are numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，象群的声音远了。
lines.en: No ground beneath me; the herd's calls fade.

lines.zh: 这个深坑里，连风都没有。
lines.en: Not even wind at the bottom of this pit.
